synthesizedFacts.fact: Zinc oxide and titanium dioxide are the only sunscreen ingredients classified as safe and effective by the FDA.
Chemical sunscreen ingredients like oxybenzone and avobenzone are absorbed into the bloodstream, but the health implications of this absorption are not fully understood.
Oxybenzone is linked to coral bleaching and potential hormone disruption.
Mineral sunscreens are recommended for children and individuals with sensitive skin due to their lack of absorption into the bloodstream.
